questions.qtext: In Little Endian Assignment of data system

options.text: lower bytes of memory word are assigned with lower addresses.
lower bytes of memory word are assigned with higher addresses.
higher bytes of memory word are assigned with lower addresses.

questions.solution:
(a)
In Little endian system, the least significant byte is stored at the lower memory address and most
significant byte is stored at the higher memory address.
